shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n'; if [ -f .lore/dod.md ]; then sed -n '1,220p' .lore/dod.md; fi"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|spec:\" scripts src *.config.* package.json .github 2>/dev/null | head -160; rg --files | rg 'CHANGELOG|changelog|jest.config|reanchor'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/types/session.ts; sed -n '1,160p' src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts; sed -n '1,160p' jest.config.js; sed -n '1,120p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|spec anchor|tests.list|\\.spec\" scripts .lore src | head -100; if [ -f scripts/reanchor-spec-links.mjs ]; then sed -n '1,80p' scripts/reanchor-spec-links.mjs; fi"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files | rg 'acceptance\\.test\\.' | head -30; rg -n \"spec:|specs/.*#\" src/*test.ts src/**/*.test.ts | head -80; sed -n '1,100p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|spec *=|@spec|validated by\" --glob '*.test.ts' --glob '*.test.tsx' --glob '*.mjs' . | head -120; git status --short; git log -5 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/usageReporting.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,130p'; tail -n 12 specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,100p' .lore/dod.md; git diff --check; git diff --stat"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --no-index /dev/null src/orchestration/usageReporting.acceptance.test.ts || true'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/usageReporting.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test: define usage reporting acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{upstream} && git log -1 --oneline'
